scientific_integrity: Wagner 1996 already proves projective all-Hibi smoothness criterion and examines local rings. The narrow contribution is an explicit complete three-crown component/intersection/transverse-model census; original full Wagner text was inaccessible, hence exact-worked-example overlap remains an explicit risk.
scientific_limitations: This determines reduced singular support, generic transverse determinantal types and finite orbit incidence for the projective normal-fan toric sixfold of the six-element crown; it does not determine Jacobian nilpotents, all local intersection germs, or larger crowns.
title: Seven singular components in the six-element crown Hibi toric sixfold
